props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it; leave it out to let `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the sheet is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the sheet asks to close (Cancel, Escape, a click outside or an action) and with `true` when `trigger` is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: The object the actions are for, such as "Kitchen lamp". It is required, because it names the sheet.

props.name: detail
props.description: One quiet line under the name, such as "lamp 02 · Kitchen".

props.name: items
props.description: The actions, three to six, in the order they are printed. Put destructive actions last.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the action's value once the sheet has closed and focus is back on the opener.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Menu`-like round key or a `Button`, that opens the sheet. The anchored panel stands by it and focus returns to it.

props.name: placement
props.description: `auto` (default) docks to the bottom edge on a screen taller than it is wide and stands by the trigger otherwise. `bottom` always docks; `anchored` always stands by the trigger.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`. `false` shows the docked lid in place, for previews.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The word on the Cancel key. Defaults to "Cancel".

props.name: children
props.description: The status word, such as "Online", "Filter due" or "offline". It is required, because status is a glyph and a word, never colour alone.

props.name: tone
props.description: Which status lamp is printed. `neutral` (default) is a hollow ring, `positive` a dot, `warning` a triangle, `critical` a square, `info` a diamond.

props.name: count
props.description: A number printed before the word in tabular figures, for the count form such as "3 offline".

props.name: tone
props.description: `neutral` (default) a standing note, `positive` a good condition, `warning` something needs care soon, `critical` something does not work. No tone is orange.

props.name: status
props.description: The status word printed beside the glyph, such as "Offline". Defaults to Note, Done, Check or Failed by tone.

props.name: children
props.description: What holds and what happens next, such as "The hub is offline. Controls will work again when it reconnects."

props.name: action
props.description: One optional plastic key that helps end the condition.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the round dismiss key and runs when it is pressed. Leave it out for a condition that must stay until it ends.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the dismiss key. Defaults to "Dismiss".

props.name: items
props.description: The sections in order, three to five of them.

props.name: current
props.description: The value of the section on screen now. Its link carries aria-current="page", medium weight and the ink mark.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when a link is pressed, with its value and the click. Call `event.preventDefault()` to route in the app instead of loading the page.

props.name: layout
props.description: `auto` (default) prints a strip along the bottom on a screen taller than it is wide and a rail at the inline start otherwise. `bar` and `rail` hold one form.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Fixes the nav to the screen edge with its safe area, for the app shell. Leave it off to place it yourself.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation landmark. Defaults to "Main".

props.name: kind
props.description: `key` (default) is a body-coloured key. `primary` is the unit's one orange key; use it once per unit.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is 44px tall; `lg` is 52px, for the main action of a sheet on a phone.

props.name: full
props.description: Stretch to the full width of the container.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Use `div` (default), `section` or `article` for a unit with its own heading, `li` inside a list of cards.

props.name: padding
props.description: The inset from the edge of the body to its content. `sm` 16px for small cards in a list, `md` (default) gap.inset (24px), `lg` 32px for a large panel, `unit` corner.inset-ratio (0.077) of the short side, like anchor A.

props.name: header
props.description: A title row on the top inset line, such as a Heading with a Text or a key at its end.

props.name: footer
props.description: A row of actions at the bottom of the body, above the printed labels.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The wordmark printed bottom-left on the inset line, such as "dial".

props.name: model
props.description: The model name printed bottom-right on the inset line. It is set in lowercase and is never the only name of the card.

props.name: onMeasure
props.description: Called with the body's measured size whenever it changes, so parts can be sized from the unit (for example a Rotary's `unitSide`).

props.name: label
props.description: The word printed beside the key. It is the accessible name, and clicking it presses the key.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the option is on, when you control it. Pair it with `onChange`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the option starts on, when the checkbox keeps its own state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the key is pressed by pointer, Space or the label; read `event.target.checked`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The key loses its height and cannot be pressed.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Some of the things this option covers are on and some are off. Shows a dash and is announced as mixed.

props.name: selected
props.description:
Whether the key is latched down (controlled). Pair it with `onSelectedChange`.
Not available on a removable chip.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description:
Whether the key starts latched when it is uncontrolled. Defaults to `false`.
Not available on a removable chip.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description:
Called with the new position each time the key is pressed by pointer, Space or Enter.
Not available on a removable chip.

props.name: onRemove
props.description:
Not available on a toggle chip. Pass `onRemove` alone for a removable chip.
Makes the chip removable, with a separate round remove key with a 44px target sits at its end.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description:
Not available on a toggle chip.
Accessible name of the remove key. Defaults to "Remove" and the word, when the word is a string.

props.name: children
props.description: The word on the key, such as "Eco" or "Night". Short, sentence case.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) draws 44px tall; `sm` draws 36px and keeps a 44px hit area around it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Flattens the chip and stops it from being pressed or removed.

props.name: icon
props.description: A small stroke icon printed before the word. It is decorative, because the word names the chip.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width. sm is 640px, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1200 (the default) and 2xl 1440.

props.name: model
props.description: The model name printed bottom-right, such as "tuner 1". Printed in lowercase.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The wordmark printed bottom-left. Defaults to "dial".

props.name: display
props.description: The window that says what the device is doing now. Always the first part of the unit.

props.name: knob
props.description: The orange knob, the unit's one loud part. It is sized to corner.knob-ratio (0.36) of the body's short side.

props.name: primary
props.description: The main key when there is no knob. It is orange only then; next to a knob it is drawn as a plastic key, so the unit never has two orange parts.

props.name: keys
props.description: Secondary keys in the body colour, for modes, bands and transport.

props.name: keysLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the row of keys, such as "Band" or "Playback".

props.name: meter
props.description: A grille meter for a reading that changes, such as volume or heat output. Leave it out when nothing is measured.

props.name: fader
props.description: A ruler fader across the body for a second amount, such as volume or brightness.

props.name: layout
props.description: `a` (default) is anchor A, with the display on top, the knob left, keys and grille right and the fader across. `tall` is one column with the knob centred, for wall devices. `compact` is a wide body with the knob right of the display.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the dialog; leave it out to let `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the dialog is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the sheet asks to close, on Escape or on any key in `actions`. Called with `true` when `trigger` is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: The one question the sheet asks, such as "Turn off all lamps?". It is required, because it names the dialog.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the question that say what will happen. It describes the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Fields or extra content between the description and the keys. The first field takes focus on open.

props.name: actions
props.description: The keys at the bottom, plastic `Button`s and at most one `Button kind="primary"`, the main one last. Any key here closes the sheet after its own onClick, unless that onClick calls `event.preventDefault()`.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Button`, that opens the sheet when pressed. Focus returns to it on close.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`, with a scrim, a focus trap and an inert page. `false` shows the sheet in place, with no scrim and no focus move, for previews.

props.name: kind
props.description: `lcd` (default) draws the value as dark 7-segment digits on grey-green; `oled` sets it in white grotesk on near-black.

props.name: value
props.description: The reading, as text. On `lcd` the digits 0 to 9, a minus, a space, a decimal point and a few letters (A b C d E F H L n o P r t U) are drawn as segments.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit printed beside the value, such as °C, min or MHz.

props.name: detail
props.description: One short line of detail with the value, such as "Heating to 22.0" or "Rinse".

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the window, such as "Thermostat". The window is announced politely when its reading changes.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` 24px digits, `md` (default) 40px digits, `lg` 56px digits; on `oled` the value line steps with it.

props.name: digits
props.description: The number of digit cells, on `lcd` only. Shorter values are padded on the left with unlit cells, so the window never changes width.

props.name: title
props.description: The printed line that says what is missing, such as "No devices in the kitchen yet". It is required.

props.name: children
props.description: One sentence that says what to do to fill the room or list, such as "Plug one in near the hub, then add it here."

props.name: action
props.description: The one key, usually a `Button`. Use `kind="primary"` only when filling this place is the screen's main action.

props.name: drawing
props.description: A quiet drawing made of the system's own parts. `none` (default) prints words only, `display` an unlit LCD window reading two dashes, `grille` a field of unlit holes. The drawing is hidden from assistive tech; the line says the same thing in words.

props.name: room
props.description: The room, such as "Living room". Printed bottom-left in the wordmark's place and used to name the unit.

props.name: temperature
props.description: The temperature, the main reading, shown on the LCD window with one decimal.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit printed beside the temperature. Default °C.

props.name: detail
props.description: One short line in the window with the temperature, such as "Feels dry". When the sensor is offline the window says Not answering instead.

props.name: displayKind
props.description: `lcd` (default) or `oled`, the window family of the Display.

props.name: readings
props.description: The levels read under the window, in order, such as humidity and air quality. Keep it to three or four.

props.name: activity
props.description: A grille for activity in the room, such as noise or a running fan. Its label is printed beside it.

props.name: readAt
props.description: When the readings were taken. Printed bottom-right in the model name's place, such as 10:42.

props.name: status
props.description: Whether the sensor is answering. A late or offline sensor keeps its last readings and says so in words.

props.name: statusText
props.description: The words of the notice line, to replace the defaults "Up to date", "No new reading since 10:17" and "Not answering since 09:58".

props.name: columns
props.description: Override the column count. By default it follows the layout tokens, which give 4, then 8 at md (768px), then 12 at lg (1024px).

props.name: span
props.description: Columns to span below md (and above, unless md/lg are set). 'full' = every column.

props.name: md
props.description: Columns to span from the md breakpoint (768px).

props.name: lg
props.description: Columns to span from the lg breakpoint (1024px).

props.name: value
props.description: The reading, from 0 to `max`. Values outside the range are clamped.

props.name: max
props.description: The top of the range. Defaults to 10.

props.name: cols
props.description: Holes per row. Defaults to 12.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of holes. Defaults to 4.

props.name: shape
props.description: `rect` (default) is a rectangular field; `circle` leaves out the holes outside the inscribed circle, like a speaker grille.

props.name: label
props.description: What the holes measure, such as "Volume" or "Fan speed". It is required, because every grille carries a reading.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill order. `inline` (default) lights holes column by column in reading order (left to right, mirrored in RTL); `up` lights rows from the bottom.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The reading as words for assistive tech. Defaults to "`value` of `max`".

props.name: level
props.description: Renders `h1` to `h4` and sets the size. 1 is display (37px, the page title), 2 headline (26px, a section), 3 title (22px, a unit, the default), 4 emphasis (18px, a group inside a unit).

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, which is required. It says in words what the key does, for example "Next track". The icon is never the name.

props.name: kind
props.description: `key` (default) is a body-coloured key. `primary` is the unit's one orange key; use it once per unit.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is a 44px disc; `lg` is 52px, for the main key of a sheet on a phone.

props.name: children
props.description: The symbol printed on the key, one icon drawn in `currentColor`. It is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it is also the field's accessible name, which `placeholder` cannot be.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well that says what to enter, for example the format.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem with the current value. When set, the field is marked invalid and the message is printed under the well with a glyph.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is a 44px well; `lg` is a 52px well with larger text, for the main field of a phone sheet.

props.name: unit
props.description: A unit printed inside the well after the value, for example `°C` or `min`. It is read out with the field.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the outer wrapper (label, well and message).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the outer wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the list for assistive tech, such as "Devices in the kitchen" or "Queue". Use it when no heading names the list.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Makes the list one listbox where a row can be chosen, as in a play queue. Rows then need a `value`, and the arrow keys move between them.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen row's value when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`. `null` means no row is chosen.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The chosen row's value at the start, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the row's value when the person chooses a different row.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the device or track, printed in primary ink. It wraps onto more lines instead of being cut.

props.name: description
props.description: The state in words under the name, such as "On · 40%" or "Ulm Quartet · 3:42".

props.name: leading
props.description: A glyph at the start of the row, such as a lamp or a speaker. It is printing only and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: index
props.description: A printed number at the start of the row, such as a track number. It takes the place of `leading`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: One part at the end of the row, such as a Switch, an IconButton, a Menu or a Badge. In a row with `href` or `onPress` it must be printing only, such as a Badge.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole row a link to this address, with a printed chevron at its end.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Makes the whole row a button that does this when pressed, such as playing the track.

props.name: chevron
props.description: Shows the printed chevron. It defaults to on for a row with `href` and off for every other row.

props.name: value
props.description: The row's value in a selectable list. It is required there and ignored elsewhere.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The row cannot be pressed or chosen; it fades to half.

props.name: tracks
props.description: The tracks in play order. The player plays them one after another.

props.name: current
props.description: The id of the track in the window when controlled. Pair it with `onCurrentChange`.

props.name: defaultCurrent
props.description: The id of the first track in the window when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first track.

props.name: onCurrentChange
props.description: Called with the new track's id when previous, next or the end of a track changes it.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called whenever the state in the window changes, such as from paused to playing.

props.name: loading
props.description: The tracks are not ready yet. The window says Loading and every part waits.

props.name: offline
props.description: The source cannot be reached. The window says Offline and play waits for the network.

props.name: volume
props.description: `slider` (default) is the ruler fader across the body; `rotary` is a plastic knob at the end of the key row.

props.name: defaultVolume
props.description: The volume at the start, from 0 to 100. Default 70.

props.name: meter
props.description: Shows the level as lit holes in a Grille beside the keys. Default true.

props.name: autoAdvance
props.description: Plays the next track when one ends. Default true.

props.name: mediaSession
props.description: Tells the operating system what is playing through the Media Session API, so lock screens and media keys work. Default true.

props.name: model
props.description: The model name printed lowercase at the lower end of the body. Default "mp 1".

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The wordmark printed at the lower start of the body. Default "dial".

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the player for assistive tech. Default "Player".

props.name: words
props.description: Your own words for the states and the keys.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the key, such as "More for Kitchen lamp". It is the accessible name of the round key, and the printed word of a word key.

props.name: items
props.description: The actions, in the order they are printed. Put destructive actions last.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called with the action's value when it runs, after the menu has closed and focus is back on the key.

props.name: trigger
props.description: `icon` (default) is a round 44px key with three dots; `word` is a capsule key with the label and a printed chevron.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph on the round key, in place of the three dots.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the key the panel lines up with. It defaults to `end` for the round key and `start` for the word key.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The key cannot be pressed and the menu cannot open.

props.name: label
props.description: What is read, such as "Battery" or "Air quality". Printed above the scale and used as the accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: The reading. Values outside the range are clamped.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value, at the start of the scale. Default 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value, at the end of the scale. Default 100.

props.name: low
props.description: Where the low region ends. Readings under it are in the low region.

props.name: high
props.description: Where the high region starts. Readings over it are in the high region.

props.name: optimum
props.description: A value in the preferred region. That region's name carries a printed bracket, and the glyph says whether the reading is in it.

props.name: regionLabels
props.description: The names of the three regions, printed under the scale and after the reading. Defaults to Low, Normal and High.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns a value into the printed and announced text, for example `(v) => v + ' %'`.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The reading in words, when `formatValue` is not enough, such as "Hard, 14 °dH". It replaces the printed value.

props.name: value
props.description: How far the task has run, from 0 to `max`. Values outside the range are clamped. Leave it out for the indeterminate form.

props.name: max
props.description: The end of the task. Defaults to 100.

props.name: label
props.description: What is running, such as "Washer" or "Firmware update". Printed above the groove and used as the accessible name.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The reading in words, printed at the end of the label line and announced, such as "38 min left". Defaults to the percent, or "Working" when indeterminate.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is an 8px groove, the main reading of a unit; `sm` is a 4px groove for rows in a list.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the list, such as "Readings" or "Living room". Printed in the bar and used to name the list region.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Asks the hub for fresh readings. Return a promise and the list shows Working until it settles; a rejected promise shows the failed line.

props.name: refreshing
props.description: Controls the working state from outside, for a refresh that the app tracks itself. Leave it out to follow the promise from `onRefresh`.

props.name: updated
props.description: When the readings were last taken. Printed as "Updated 10:42". A refresh that succeeds sets it to the time it ended; with `refreshing` the app passes the new time here.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Turns the time into the printed text. Defaults to hours and minutes on a 24 hour clock, such as 10:42.

props.name: height
props.description: The tallest the list may grow before it scrolls, in px or any CSS length. Leave it out to let the page scroll.

props.name: messages
props.description: The words printed and spoken, for other languages.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The pull and the refresh key do nothing.

props.name: children
props.description: The list.

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the list for assistive tech. Default "Up next".

props.name: tracks
props.description: The tracks in order when controlled. Pair it with `onTracksChange`.

props.name: defaultTracks
props.description: The tracks at the start when uncontrolled.

props.name: onTracksChange
props.description: Called with the tracks in their new order after a move or a removal.

props.name: playing
props.description: The id of the track that is playing. Its row gets the ink index mark and the word Playing.

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Called with a track's id when its row is pressed, to play it.

props.name: removable
props.description: Lets the person remove tracks from the menu or with Delete. Default true.

props.name: words
props.description: Your own words for the menu and the announcements.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the fader. It is required, because it names both caps.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value, at the start of the groove. Default 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value, at the end of the groove. Default 10.

props.name: step
props.description: The distance between detents. Each cap settles into the nearest detent and the ruler prints one tick per detent (up to 20).

props.name: minGap
props.description: The smallest distance the two caps keep between them. Default 0, so both caps may stand on the same value.

props.name: value
props.description: The low and high values when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting values when uncontrolled. Defaults to the two ends.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with both values whenever a key, a drag or a press moves one cap to another value.

props.name: lowLabel
props.description: The announced name of the low cap, after the label. Default "Low".

props.name: highLabel
props.description: The announced name of the high cap, after the label. Default "High".

props.name: scale
props.description: Print the ruler's numerals under the groove. Default false.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns a value into the printed and announced text, for example `(v) => v + ' °C'`.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: The distance PageUp and PageDown move. It defaults to a tenth of the range, and at least two detents.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The fader cannot be moved; both caps lose their height.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass of each cap. Default 1.4 (mechanism.mass).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness. Default 520 (mechanism.stiffness).

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping. Default 46 (mechanism.damping).

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name under the knob. It is required, because it is also the knob's accessible name.

props.name: kind
props.description: `primary` (default) is the unit's one orange knob; use it once per unit. `key` is a body-coloured knob for secondary dials.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` is 44px, `md` (default) 72px, `lg` 108px across. Ignored when `diameter` or `unitSide` is set.

props.name: diameter
props.description: The knob's diameter in px, at least 44. Overrides `size` and `unitSide`.

props.name: unitSide
props.description: The short side of the unit the knob sits on, in px. The diameter becomes `knobRatio` × this, which is 0.36 in anchor A.

props.name: knobRatio
props.description: The share of the unit's short side the knob takes when `unitSide` is set. Default 0.36 (corner.knob-ratio).

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value, at the start of the sweep. Default 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value, at the end of the sweep. Default 10.

props.name: step
props.description: The distance between detents. Default 1, so 0 to 10 gives the 11 detents of mechanism.detents.

props.name: value
props.description: The value when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled. Default `min`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value whenever a key or a drag turns the knob to another detent.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns a value into the printed and announced text, for example `(v) => v + ' °C'`.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: The distance PageUp and PageDown turn. It defaults to a tenth of the range, and at least two detents.

props.name: sweep
props.description: The angle from the first detent to the last, in degrees. Default 270 (mechanism.sweep).

props.name: dragDistance
props.description: How far, in px, a vertical drag goes to turn through the whole sweep. Default 180.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The knob cannot be turned; it loses its height.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass of the knob. Default 1.4 (mechanism.mass).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness. Default 520 (mechanism.stiffness).

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping. Default 46 (mechanism.damping).

props.name: label
props.description: What is playing, such as the track's title. It is printed above the groove and is the scrubber's accessible name.

props.name: duration
props.description: The length of the track, in seconds.

props.name: value
props.description: The position when controlled, in seconds. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting position when uncontrolled, in seconds. Default 0.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new position, in whole seconds, while a key, a drag or a press moves the cap.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called once with the final position when a drag ends or a key is pressed, the moment to seek a player that cannot seek while dragging.

props.name: buffered
props.description: How far the track has loaded, in seconds. The groove floor up to there is drawn one ink step darker.

props.name: chapters
props.description: Chapter starts, printed as ink marks above the groove.

props.name: step
props.description: How far the arrow keys move, in seconds. Default 5.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: How far PageUp and PageDown move, in seconds. Default 30.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing is loaded yet; the cap loses its height and cannot be moved.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass of the cap. Default 1.4 (mechanism.mass).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness. Default 520 (mechanism.stiffness).

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping. Default 46 (mechanism.damping).

props.name: label
props.description: The name printed above the bank, such as Band or Mode. It is required, because it is also the group's accessible name.

props.name: options
props.description: The keys, in order. Two to five keys fit a unit; more belong in a Select.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the latched key, when you control it. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the key latched at first, when the bank keeps its own state. With neither, no key is latched until one is pressed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when a key latches, by pointer, arrow keys, Home, End or Space.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) keys are 44px tall; `lg` keys are 52px, for a phone sheet.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every key loses its height and none can be pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it is also the field's accessible name.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in the order they are listed.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`. `null` means nothing is chosen yet.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the option's value when the person picks a different option.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: A prompt shown in the well before anything is chosen, such as "Choose a programme". It never replaces the label.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default) is a 44px well; `lg` is a 52px well with larger text, for the main choice of a phone sheet.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The field cannot be opened; the well loses its shadow and fades to half.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the chosen value with a form under this name, through a hidden input.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the sheet; leave it out to let `trigger` open it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state on first render when the sheet is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` when the sheet asks to close (the close key, Escape, a scrim click or a drag down) and with `true` when `trigger` is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: The device the sheet controls, such as "Living room lamp". It is required, because it names the sheet.

props.name: model
props.description: The model name printed lowercase beside the title, such as "lamp 02". It is never the only name of the sheet.

props.name: children
props.description: The device's controls, a Display first and then faders, switches and rows. They act at once, so the sheet needs no Save key.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional keys at the bottom, such as "Remove device". At most one `Button kind="primary"`.

props.name: trigger
props.type: ReactElement<{ onClick?: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void); }, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
props.description: An element, usually a `Button`, that opens the sheet when pressed. Focus returns to it on close.

props.name: placement
props.description: `auto` (default) docks to the bottom edge on a screen taller than it is wide and stands at the lower inline end otherwise. `bottom` always docks; `end` always stands at the end.

props.name: modal
props.description: `true` (default) opens with `showModal()`, with a scrim, a focus trap and an inert page. `false` shows the sheet in place, for previews.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the round close key in the header. Defaults to "Close".

props.name: kind
props.description: What is still loading. `text` (default) is lines of text, `display` a Display reading, `grille` a Grille meter, `disc` a key or knob, `block` a chart or picture area.

props.name: size
props.description: Matches the size of the part that will replace it. For `text` it is caption, body (default) or title type. For `display` it is 24, 40 or 56px digits. For `disc` it is a 44, 72 or 108px part.

props.name: lines
props.description: The number of text lines, on `text` only. Default 1.

props.name: lastLine
props.description: The width of the last text line as a share of the others, from 0 to 1. Default 1 for one line and 0.6 for more.

props.name: extent
props.description: The inline size of a `text` placeholder, or the diameter of a `disc` or the block size of a `block`, in px or any CSS length.

props.name: digits
props.description: The number of digit cells, on `display` only. Use the `digits` of the Display it stands for. Default 4.

props.name: unit
props.description: The unit the Display will print, on `display` only. It is kept hidden, so the window reserves its width.

props.name: detail
props.description: Reserves the Display's detail line, on `display` only.

props.name: cols
props.description: The grille's columns, on `grille` only. Use the `cols` of the Grille it stands for. Default 6.

props.name: rows
props.description: The grille's rows, on `grille` only. Default 3.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the fader. It is required, because it is also the slider's accessible name.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value, at the start of the groove. Default 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value, at the end of the groove. Default 10.

props.name: step
props.description: The distance between detents. When set, the cap settles into the nearest detent and the ruler prints one tick per detent (up to 20). Leave it out for a fader with no detents.

props.name: value
props.description: The value when controlled. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value when uncontrolled. Default `min`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value whenever a key, a drag or a click moves the cap to another value.

props.name: scale
props.description: Print the ruler's numerals under the groove ("audio 1" scale). Default false.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns a value into the printed and announced text, for example `(v) => v + ' %'`.

props.name: pageStep
props.description: The distance PageUp and PageDown move. It defaults to a tenth of the range, and at least two detents.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The fader cannot be moved; the cap loses its height.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass of the cap. Default 1.4 (mechanism.mass).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness. Default 520 (mechanism.stiffness).

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring damping. Default 46 (mechanism.damping).

props.name: duration
props.description: Default time on screen in ms. Never less than 5000.

props.name: aboveNav
props.description: `true` (default) lifts the snackbar above a BottomNav strip on a tall screen. Set `false` for an app with no bottom nav.

props.name: tone
props.description: `positive` (default) the action worked, `neutral` a plain note, `warning` it worked with a catch, `critical` it failed. No tone is orange.

props.name: status
props.description: The status word printed beside the glyph. Defaults to Done, Note, Check or Failed by tone.

props.name: children
props.description: The message, short and in the past tense, such as "Lamp removed".

props.name: action
props.description: At most one plastic key, the action that undoes, such as Undo.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Runs after the action key is pressed, so the owner can close the snackbar.

props.name: direction
props.description: `column` (default) stacks vertically; `row` lays out inline and wraps.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children. xs is 4px, sm 8, md 16 (the default), lg 24 and xl 32.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: label
props.description: What the switch turns on or off, printed beside it. It names the switch for assistive tech. Without it, pass `aria-label`.

props.name: onLabel
props.description: Word printed at the on end of the groove, such as "On" or "Cook". Printing only; the state is announced by the role.

props.name: offLabel
props.description: Word printed at the off end of the groove, such as "Off" or "Warm". Printing only; the state is announced by the role.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is on (controlled). Pair it with `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the switch starts on when it is uncontrolled. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new position each time the switch is thrown by pointer, Space or Enter.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Flattens the cap and stops the switch from being thrown.

props.name: label
props.description: What the sections are, such as Rooms. It is required, because it is the accessible name of the row of names.

props.name: items
props.description: The sections in order. Each has a value, a printed name and its content.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the chosen section, when you control it. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The section chosen at first, when the tabs keep their own state. It defaults to the first item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when another section is chosen.

props.name: activation
props.description: With `automatic` (default) the arrow keys choose the section they reach, because every panel is already on the page. With `manual` the arrows only move focus and Enter or Space chooses, for panels that are slow to show.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Use `p` (default) for a paragraph, `span` inline, `div` for a block, `label` to name a field (pass `htmlFor`).

props.name: size
props.description: `micro` (11px, model names and scale numerals), `caption` (13px), `label` (14px), `body` (15px, the default) or `reading` (16px, prose capped at the measure).

props.name: tone
props.description: `primary` (default) is the darkest ink on plastic; `secondary` is one step lighter for notes and units. Both hold 4.5:1.

props.name: weight
props.description: `regular` (default) or `medium`. There is no bold and no italic.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular figures, so a number that changes keeps its width.

props.name: label
props.description: The printed name above the well. It is required, because it also names the group of fields.

props.name: kind
props.description: `segment` (default) draws hour and minute as 7-segment figures, like a clock radio. `text` sets them in the grotesk, for dense forms.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: `24` (default) runs the hour through 00 to 23. With `12` the hour stops at 12 and AM and PM are printed in the well.

props.name: value
props.description: The time when controlled, as `HH:MM` on the 24 hour clock, or an empty string when it is not set. Pair it with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting time when uncontrolled, as `HH:MM` on the 24 hour clock. Leave it out to start with no time set.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new time as `HH:MM` whenever a field steps, or with an empty string while hour or minute is not set.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: How far the arrow keys and set keys move the minute. Default 1.

props.name: keys
props.description: Shows the round set keys under hour and minute. Default true for `segment` and false for `text`.

props.name: hint
props.description: A short line printed under the well, for example the time zone or what the time starts.

props.name: error
props.description: The problem with the current time. When set, the fields are marked invalid and the message is printed with a glyph.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The fields cannot be changed and the set keys are not shown.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The time can be read and focused but not changed, and the set keys are not shown.

props.name: required
props.description: The time must be set before the form is sent.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of a hidden form field that carries the time as `HH:MM`.

props.name: hourLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the hour field. Default "Hour".

props.name: minuteLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the minute field. Default "Minute".

props.name: periodLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the AM and PM field. Default "AM or PM".

props.name: periodWords
props.description: The printed words for the two halves of the day. Default `['AM', 'PM']`.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: The names of the four set keys, in the order hour down, hour up, minute down, minute up.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default time on screen in ms for toasts without an action. Never less than 5000.

props.name: max
props.description: How many toasts show at once; older ones close first.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the region. Defaults to "Notifications".

props.name: tone
props.description: `neutral` (default) a plain note, `positive` the action worked, `warning` it worked with a catch, `critical` it failed. No tone is orange.

props.name: status
props.description: The status word printed beside the glyph. Defaults to Note, Done, Check or Failed by tone.

props.name: children
props.description: The message, short and in the past tense, such as "Lamp turned off".

props.name: action
props.description: One optional plastic key, such as Undo or Try again.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows the round close key and runs when it is pressed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the close key. Defaults to "Close".
